original_test_intent: Verify all expected POWER DIMM Zone1 through ZoneN sensors are correctly mapped and their aggregate values, units, status and thresholds are human-readable and match the approved DIMM-zone power specification.
original_method: Enumerate each expected DIMM-zone power channel and immutable raw/UI identity, map its contributing DIMMs, collect complete value/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized population, health, workload and temperature context, and compare raw and WebUI results to the owner aggregation contract.
manual_activity: The owner provides zone membership and aggregation/unit/threshold rules; an operator verifies raw/UI readability and topology correlation, and the owner adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: Zone1..N to physical DIMM membership and SDR/Redfish/UI mapping
Watt unit/scale, aggregation window/method, thresholds and expected ranges
Read-only DIMM health, memory workload and temperature context
UI refresh/rounding tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep access read-only; never change memory power policy, thresholds, workload or thermal controls
Use protected authentication and complete non-truncated enumeration
Bind each aggregate sample to zone membership, DIMM population and synchronized context
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on missing/duplicate membership, negative/stale power, threshold alarm or memory/BMC health fault
Do not alter workload or refresh repeatedly to manufacture an expected value
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate and verify all DIMM-zone sensors and physical memberships
Collect complete raw values, units, status, thresholds, identities and timestamps with read-only context
Assist with synchronized WebUI capture and approved aggregation/unit normalization
Report missing, extra, duplicate, stale, membership and raw/UI/spec mismatches for owner verdict
Perform no memory or power-policy mutation or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Supply authoritative zone map, aggregation method, units, thresholds and tolerances
Review topology, raw/UI/context and aggregate discrepancies

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool may expose raw records, but a literal Zone1~N name and head-limited fallback cannot prove every zone, DIMM membership, aggregation, complete thresholds or UI consistency.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely enumerate the full SDR/Redfish inventory, select all owner-mapped DIMM-zone power records, capture full metadata and synchronized DIMM context, then correlate each WebUI row to the aggregation specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: POWER DIMM Zone1~N scope, WebUI path, reading/threshold/spec comparison and 1/0-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PACKAGE-GATED DIMM-ZONE AGGREGATE POWER VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-zone matrix containing member DIMMs, raw watts/unit/status/threshold, population/health/workload/thermal context and UI display, with completeness and aggregation-comparison results.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical membership and aggregation semantics while replacing insecure/truncated generic reads and log clearing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One zone value or screenshot does not cover Zone1..N or prove member composition. Every expected zone and its contributing DIMMs must be accounted for.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A vendor zone can span channels, sockets or memory domains and may use filtered estimates rather than a direct sum; only the project aggregation contract defines a valid comparison.

project_override_considerations: If empty zones are omitted or zones share DIMMs under a platform-specific grouping, the owner must define the expected population, membership and not-present behavior without substituting CPU or PSU telemetry.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/firmware/DIMM topology/spec revision
Per-zone DIMM membership and raw/UI sensor identity matrix
Synchronized WebUI screenshots and approved aggregation/rounding comparison
Per-zone discrepancies, no-write/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently target DIMM-zone power readings and thresholds. Membership and aggregation details are necessary project inputs, not contradictory source statements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Zone map, aggregation specification, complete raw/UI data and memory context gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Makes zone membership and aggregation auditable and requires complete per-zone raw/UI/context evidence rather than accepting a wildcard-like name read.
independent_technical_reasoning: A zone-power value has no stable meaning until its contributing DIMMs and aggregation window are known. Population changes can legitimately add, remove or reshape zones, while a plausible watt number can still be mapped to the wrong memory domain. Correct review therefore requires an explicit zone-to-DIMM matrix and synchronized health/workload/temperature context. CPU or PSU power cannot stand in for this narrower aggregation domain.
